Task: list the RIVALRIES and ALLIANCES that existed in January 1946 among these entities.
Rules: use ONLY ids from the roster, never ISO codes or invented ids. Each pair listed once. A dependent entity normally has no foreign policy of its own - skip it unless it genuinely acted on its own (a disputed administration fighting its overlord counts). Prefer pairs a player would recognise as driving 1946-1960: the emerging Cold War, civil wars, colonial conflicts, regional confrontations.
Answer with JSON ONLY: {"rivalries":[{"a":"XXX","b":"YYY","why":"<=10 words"}],"alliances":[{"a":"XXX","b":"YYY","why":"<=10 words"}]}
